title: Unverified account
why: Checks that an account with nothing verified (email, phone, passport, 2FA) can sign in or register but is stopped from actions that need verified details, such as making a booking.

steps.does: Sign in as tomas.berglund@example.com with the correct password, then try to book a seat on a flight.

expect: If the system requires a confirmed email to sign in, sign-in is refused with an unconfirmed-email result. If sign-in is allowed, the booking is refused because the email is unconfirmed and the passport number is empty. No 2FA challenge is raised because TwoFactorEnabled is false. No booking row is created.
